name: npc-ethereal-lace
source: Lace (placeholder name; the owner's Meshy title 'Ethereal Lace'), a street resident of the Avenue. The owner's own Meshy generation was sculpted with her hands clasped at her chest, so its auto-rig tore her arms and hair in any arm movement; on 18 Nov 2026 she was remade standing in an A-pose on his Meshy account: image-to-image (nano-banana-pro) from a front render of the original, image-to-3d, remesh 45k and auto-rig 1.65 m; prepared by prepare_meshy.py. Casual street clips only.
